correctness.rationale: Exact geometric likelihood and rare-bin cancellation yield D=|N2/n-q^2|+O_P(sqrt(q^3/n)+q/n) for nq diverging. Elementary binomial triangular-array limits give first three regimes. The B=0 finite identity D=A^2/[n(n+A)] gives the last and bootstrap tail by monotonicity. All quantifiers and zero-estimate cases documented. Checker passed 1,890 finite identities; numerical output is only corroboration.

value.rationale: The cancellation of fitted first-bin noise makes second-bin occupancy the calibration bottleneck and produces a non-Gaussian law at nq^2 order one; nq order one adds estimator nonexistence and a nonuniform bootstrap tail. These scales explain when increasing bin resolution destroys existing goodness-of-fit inference. Directly useful to calibration and bin-width choice, not a routine MLE calculation.
